newsitem.title: ISRAEL: EDS wins Tnuva Israel tender.
newsitem.headline: EDS wins Tnuva Israel tender.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems (EDS) said on Wednesday it had won a tender to provide outsourcing services for the computerised activities of Tnuva Co-Op, which markets agricultural produce in Israel.

It said Tnuva, Israel's largest marketing and trading company, accepted its $40 million five-year offer in the final stage of a screening process. A spokeswoman said the two sides would now enter negotiations for a contract.
"Our estimate is that the negotiations will take a month or two," the spokeswoman told Reuters, adding that it would be the largest outsourcing contract awarded to EDS in Israel.
EDS will carry out all of Tnuva's current computerised activities and 70 workers in Tnuva's computer unit will become EDS employees.
EDS signed a five-year agreement last month with Israel Military Industries worth $35 million for the outsourcing of its computer unit.
"The two contracts indicate that the Israeli market is ripe for outsourcing transactions," said Israel Koren, president of EDS Israel.
